Files.description: Reference material. None of it is shown to the agent.

patch.description: The upstream fix, as a diff against the source directory.
patch.title: Patch

future_test.description: Hidden tests of the fix, usually those added upstream, as a diff. The intent test applies it and runs scripts.test.
future_test.title: Future Test

security_test.description: Regression test for the vulnerability, as a diff. Kept for reference: the grader does not apply it, and its security check runs the proofs of concept instead.
security_test.title: Security Test

intent_test.description: Tests of the intended behaviour, as a diff. Kept for reference: the intent test uses future_test.
intent_test.title: Intent Test

poc.description: Proof-of-concept inputs, each run with scripts.run.
poc.title: Poc

Files.title: Files

Scripts.description: Scripts that the grader and the agent's test_patch tool run.

build.description: Builds the project in the source directory.
build.title: Build

run.description: Runs the proof of concept given as its argument.
run.title: Run

Scripts.title: Scripts

TaskDescription.description: What the agent is told about the vulnerability. At least one field must be set.

issue.description: Issue text given to the agent.
issue.title: Issue

crash_report.description: Report files given to the agent, such as the upstream issue or a sanitizer log.
crash_report.title: Crash Report

bug_description.description: Short description of the bug given to the agent.
bug_description.title: Bug Description

TaskDescription.title: TaskDescription

description:
A task's configuration, `sse/config.yaml` in the task folder.

Paths are relative to /ssebench in the case image, which the task's Dockerfile fills from `sse/`.

id.description: Task ID, equal to the task's folder name.
id.title: Id

language.description: Language of the project. The case image builds on the base image of that language.
language.title: Language

source.description: Absolute path of the project's source tree in the case image.
source.title: Source

sanitizer.description: Sanitizer the build enables, such as address.
sanitizer.title: Sanitizer

type.description: Class of the bug, such as Heap Buffer Overflow or a CWE.
type.title: Type

binary.description: Program or harness that the proofs of concept exercise.
binary.title: Binary

trigger_commit.description: Upstream revision that the case image builds.
trigger_commit.title: Trigger Commit

patch_commit.description: Upstream commits that fix the bug, comma-separated.
patch_commit.title: Patch Commit

reference.description: Links to the advisory, the report and the fix.
reference.title: Reference

originality.description: Origin of the proofs of concept: public when they come from the public report or advisory, possibly adapted; crafted when they were written for the task because the report has no reproducer.
originality.title: Originality

title: SSEBench task config
